items.title: Houthis announce fresh Wednesday-evening claim of ballistic-missile targeting of King Khalid airport
items.summary: A Sky News Arabia push notification (Reuters-sourced, sent 17:43 UTC Wednesday) announced that the Houthis targeted King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh with ballistic missiles. The announcement was echoed within minutes as 'breaking' graphics by Al Jazeera, TRT Arabi and alrasheedmedia on social. It follows the Wednesday-morning coalition intercept over Riyadh (missile destroyed; air-raid alert lifted) and the Houthi side's broader morning claim of a multi-weapon strike operation on Aramco Dhahran, King Khalid airport and a Riyadh refinery. No coalition response or damage details reported yet for this new claim.
items.source_name: Sky News Arabia (push via Project Push)
